description: This file defines a BestSeller controller class for the OpenCart platform, responsible for fetching and rendering the list of best-selling products on the storefront's bestseller module.

classes.name: BestSeller
classes.description: Controller class for handling the bestseller module in OpenCart, extending the core Controller class, responsible for gathering product data and rendering the bestseller view.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method that loads the language, models, retrieves bestseller products based on settings, processes product data including images, prices, and descriptions, and returns the rendered view of the bestseller module.
